semanticCoverage.assessment: All x/v_x and capacitor-q/current-i quantities retained; physical distinction retained. Standalone boundary defect is D292-EN-01.
Similar time evolution, similar production conditions and restoring elastic force retained.
Restoring force magnitude proportional to displacement magnitude, k, U=q/C and reciprocal capacitance retained.

scienceReview.reasoning: The English specifies force magnitude versus displacement magnitude, avoiding a positive signed F_x=kx restoring-law error. U=q/C is for the selected capacitor polarity. Linear spring and ideal LC teaching model are assumed as in the source.

Finite force/inductor voltage produce finite rates of change, so velocity/current do not jump to zero when their driving force/voltage vanishes. "Can increase" does not claim forces always increase speed. Inertia and self-induction glosses explain the existing terms.

m*v_x^2/2 corresponds to L*i^2/2 (kinetic/magnetic); k*x_m^2/2 corresponds to q_m^2/(2C) (spring/electric). Thus x corresponds to q, v_x to i, m to L and k to 1/C, not numerical or dimensional equality. No signs, powers or coefficients were changed.

The derivative sentence explicitly defines signed transferred charge, positive in the chosen current direction. For outward current from a discharging plate, q_transferred=Q_initial-Q_remaining and i=q_transferred_prime=-Q_remaining_prime. The earlier capacitor charge in U=q/C and its stored energy is a plate-charge quantity, not universally the transferred-charge variable in the derivative sentence. The current candidate does not assert i=+Q_remaining_prime for outward discharge. This source-context reuse of q must not be collapsed by a later table/figure binding.

Spring oscillator, periodic change, velocity component, equilibrium, inertia, self-induction, capacitance, magnetic energy, potential energy and time derivative receive concrete glosses without new exercises or examples. Prior spring/capacitor/circuit study is assumed by N19. Standalone paragraph clarity fails separately at D292-EN-01; this is not blanket age-suitability approval of the delivered flow.

All five textual source blocks and the unchanged ten Chinese paragraph meanings are covered in twelve native English paragraphs. The battery detail omitted in already approved Chinese is likewise not reintroduced; charging itself remains. No lost source caption, exercise, example or table cell is fabricated.

Source snapshots, hashes, refs, chapter/section, page numbering and six-block identity agree with canonical N19 and raw text blocks. Cyrillic maximum m and subfigure b aliases are permitted notation localization, not new variables. EN heading/breadcrumb/Table translations are faithful sidecar authoring strings, not an implemented runtime overlay or native unnumbered-table alias approval.
